integrity: The proof combines the published extremality of the alternating-arch construction with an independent exact characterization of its shortest absent subsequences as weak zigzags. A standalone verifier cross-checks direct subsequence enumeration, threshold-graph dynamic programming, the reverse-accumulate recurrence, and exhaustive small-word stress tests.
scientific_limitations: The formula is for shortest absent subsequences of length one more than the universality index. It does not solve the arbitrary-longer-length absent-subsequence counting problem, and it does not claim uniqueness of extremal words.
title: Exact shortest-absent-subsequence maxima are threshold-graph walk numbers
